title: Where Latents Belong and How They Flow: Joint Identification of Structural Roles
abstract: arXiv:2610.23074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent factors in dynamical systems can play different roles across observations and time. For example, an idea in a group meeting may be expressed by only some participants, inherit information from earlier discussions, and shape what is said next. We formalize this notion as the structural role of a latent factor, describing where it is expressed, whether it receives influence from the past, and whether it transmits influence to the future. The main challenge is correspondence, since the three structures may be identified under different permutations, while a structural role is defined only when they are aligned to the same latent coordinate. We show that, under suitable structural and variability conditions, all three roles are jointly identifiable under a common permutation at each time point. Guided by this theory, we develop RoleTrace, a framework that traces structural roles in a shared latent coordinate system. Synthetic experime

translated_title: 潜变量属于何处以及如何流动：结构角色的联合识别
translated_abstract: 动力系统中的潜在因子在不同观测和时间上可以扮演不同的角色。例如，小组会议中的一个想法可能只由部分参与者表达，从早先的讨论中继承信息，并影响接下来所说的内容。我们将这一概念形式化为潜在因子的“结构角色”，用以描述它在何处被表达、是否从过去接收影响，以及是否向未来传递影响。主要挑战在于对应关系问题，因为这三种结构可能在不同置换下被识别，而结构角色只有在它们对齐到同一潜在坐标时才能被定义。我们证明，在适当的结构与变异性条件下，所有三种角色在每个时间点上都可以在共同置换下被联合识别。基于这一理论，我们开发了RoleTrace，一个在共享潜在坐标系中追踪结构角色的框架。合成实验……
tldr: 该论文形式化了动力系统中潜在因子的“结构角色”概念，证明了表达位置、接收过去影响与传递未来影响这三种角色可在共同置换下于每个时间点联合识别，并据此开发了在共享潜在坐标系中追踪结构角色的RoleTrace框架。
